notes.title: Version.2.0
notes.content:
Added 3 stages to the mission mode.
Chinchilla Stage: Appears with a total score of 5000 points or more.
100 Crocodile Stage: Appears after the ending.
Emperor Battle: Appears after the ending.

notes.title: Ver.1.2
notes.content:
Added stages to mission mode, added visuals and effects, and adjusted game balance.
ミッションモードにステージを追加、ビジュアルとエフェクトを追加、ゲームバランスの調整をしました。

notes.title: ver.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed some game balance and display bugs.
一部ゲームバランス、表示の不具合を修正。
